resourceAndProviderGuards.qualification: The plan may be committed, but a provider request must not start until a fresh sample leaves at least 3 GiB commit headroom after the one-worker reservation. No provider request has been issued.

acceptanceCriteria: Plan and selection regenerate byte-identically from current committed county shards.
A fresh pre-request resource sample preserves at least 3 GiB system commit headroom after the one-worker reservation.
The authenticated provider request completes with retained terminal metadata, DOI, license, archive bytes, and SHA-256 under the 256 MiB cap.
Interpreted and verbatim Darwin Core rows reconcile under the exact geography and conservative evidence contract.
Every selected pair moves exactly once to verified-present or researched-unresolved; no selected pair remains not-researched.
All immutable run receipts, outputs, generated projections, source coverage, and publication artifacts pass current integrity gates.
Any R2 publication remains below the project 8 GB, 800000 Class A, and 8000000 Class B safety stops with billable usage still zero.
Production identity, same-origin R2 delivery, changed outcomes, and representative routes pass external verification before a release receipt is claimed.

decision.reason: The current portfolio, coverage, zero-network preflight, credentials, exact evidence contract, and explicit production authority select Round 75 GBIF. The interrupted-turn resource sample independently stopped acquisition before network until the mandatory projected post-worker commit-headroom floor passes.
